result:
Done! The theme and application shell are built and compiling successfully. Here's what landed:

## Theme Palette ✅
Updated `src/styles.css` with the build spec's colors in oklch format:
- **Light**: Amber primary (#d8891a), cool indigo-gray neutrals, white cards
- **Dark**: Lighter amber (#f5b843), dark blue-gray neutrals, dark cards
- **Sidebar**: Permanently dark in both themes (per spec)
- **Semantic**: Success green, warning orange, destructive red, info blue

## Application Shell ✅
Built in `src/app/app.html` with:
- **Navigation rail**: Dark `hlm-sidebar` with six routes + theme toggle in footer
  - Dashboard, Roster, Missions, Threats, Recruit, Settings
  - Mobile: off-canvas drawer (handled by sidebar component)
  - Desktop: always-visible rail
- **Top bar**: Mobile menu trigger, breadcrumb, search, notifications, theme toggle, avatar
- **Main content**: Router outlet with flex-1 scrolling region
- **Layout**: Flex row (rail + content), respects 375/768/1280px responsive breakpoints

## Theme Switcher ✅
`src/app/app.view-model.ts` manages:
- Toggle `.dark` class on `<html>`
- Persist choice to localStorage
- Respect `prefers-color-scheme` on first visit
- Wired into sidebar footer button with sun/moon icons

## Routes ✅
Six lazy-loaded destinations:
- `/dashboard` → Dashboard placeholder
- `/roster` → Heroes list (reused Heroes component)
- `/detail/:id` → Hero detail
- `/missions` → Missions placeholder
- `/threats` → Threats placeholder
- `/recruit` → Recruit placeholder
- `/settings` → Settings placeholder

## Build Status ✅
Compiles cleanly with `ng build`. All gates pass:
- Layout gate (grid/flex, CSS tokens only)
- Sealing gate (primitives used correctly, no appearance classes)
- Component shape gate (MVVM, ViewModel provides state)
- No horizontal scroll at 375/768/1280px

The app is ready for feature stages to fill in the screen implementations.
